title: Security control v1
description: config/security/controls/<id>.json (PADRAO-DEV F7d, D-321): one control of a reference catalog (NIST SP 800-218, the SSDF, first) and the repository's statement of its applicability (ISO/IEC 27001 Statement of Applicability): whether it applies and why, what implements it and how fully. The state is derived (implemented, partial, gap, not-applicable).

implemented_by.description: The rules, tests, checks or records that implement it.

coverage.description: Whether what implements it covers the whole control.
